title: fix(ci): a pm:blocked card parked on a PR is released only once that PR merged
body:

_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DHhgHQDAHKBCzHFgXt1hdVB)_

domain:skills#2 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cxBhj4jCJgyxHY42p5

Fixes #27846

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`triage-duties.md` 加一行:分诊把卡挂 `pm:blocked` 时,同一笔在卡正文写行首 `Blocked-by: #N`(issue 或 PR 号;整点全量红卡写在评论里),散文提及不算。整点全量红卡刷新时的放回判断,目标是 PR 的只认「已合并」:关闭未合并的 PR 不再把卡放回队列。
- 为什么改:今晚 14 张 server 卡因为分诊只在评论散文里写「blocked on PR #N」,PR 合并后没有任何机制把它们放回,车道一直报「没卡」。实测还发现,刷新读者把关闭未合并的 PR 也读成「已关」并照样放卡,和它自己写的「关闭即修复已进 main」相矛盾。
- 风险与回滚:只动内部 PM 规则文本和 `scripts/ci/` 下的工具,不发布任何包。放回只会更严(多一种「不放」),不会多放。回滚即 revert。
- 先看:`scripts/ci/scheduled-full-run.mjs` 的 `judgeCardBlock` 与 `staleBlockVerdict`;`scripts/ci/scheduled-full-run-card.mjs` 的 `getIssue`;`triage-duties.md` 第 36 行。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/ci/scheduled-full-run.mjs --self-test && node scripts/ci/scheduled-full-run-card.mjs --self-test`,预期两行都报 OK(后者 8 个用例)。
- 需要你做的:契约复审(contract review)尚欠,由席位达档复审;落地档位以登记册为准(`node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --pr` 本 PR 号)。

## What changes

**The release reader tells a merged PR from an abandoned one.** When the hourly full-run card is refreshed while it carries `pm:blocked`, every `Blocked-by:` target is resolved through `issues.get`, and the card step kept only `{ state, closed_at }`. The issues API answers a PR number `closed` whether it merged or was closed unmerged, so a closed-unmerged PR released the card, against this file's own rationale ("whose closure means its fix landed on this `main`"). Measured before the fix by driving `judgeCardBlock` with that projection: merged → `expired`, closed unmerged → `expired`, open → `held`.

- `scripts/ci/scheduled-full-run-card.mjs`: `getIssue` now carries `pull_request.merged_at` when the answer is a PR (no extra call: `issues.get` already returns it).
- `scripts/ci/scheduled-full-run.mjs`: `judgeCardBlock` marks a closed PR with no `merged_at` as `unmerged: true` (a missing `merged_at` reads the same, so the unknown case holds). `staleBlockVerdict` holds on it, and the summary row names it (`#N closed unmerged (a PR that never landed)`). THE RULE table gains the row.

**Triage names its park line.** `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md` gains: 「停 `pm:blocked` 同笔在卡正文写行首 `Blocked-by: #N`(issue/PR 号;full-run 卡写评论),散文不算。」 This is triage's option 1 as ruled in 6513844891. The line is paid in the same file: the two reporting-discipline bullets fold into one, dropping 「⛔ 不弹给维护者」 (already implied by 「只进座位贴和触发器」) and 「运维」. The file stays at 102 lines, its ceiling row is untouched, and no line exceeds 120 bytes.

## Why

Triage parked cards with `pm:blocked on PR #N` in comment prose and no line-initial `Blocked-by:`. No unlock path reads prose, so 14 `domain:server` cards whose PR had merged sat blocked while seats reported nothing claimable.

## Tests

- `scheduled-full-run.mjs --self-test`, battery "card refresh: a stale pm:blocked": a park on a PR, body channel and comment channel, MERGED → released to `pm:queue`; the same PR closed UNMERGED → held, no label write, no note, the summary names the abandoned PR; the same PR OPEN → held.
- `scheduled-full-run-card.mjs --self-test`: new case "a pm:blocked card whose blocker is a PR closed unmerged is held": `issues.get` answers the PR shape (`pull_request.merged_at: null`), the step makes no `addLabels`/`removeLabel` call and reports `block: held -- #601 closed unmerged (a PR that never landed)`. The battery roster gains the row and its floor moves 7 → 8.

## Acceptance notes

Out of this card's surface. The seat files one follow-up card for triage:

- **`scheduled-full-run` judges only its own CI card**, and only on a new red. It never reads any other `pm:blocked` card, so it would not have released the 14 stranded cards even with a body line. Ordinary cards are still released only by the seat and triage unlock scans.
- **The hourly reverse unlock scan never sees a PR.** `dispatch-runbook.md` 〈分诊两级盘点细则〉 item 2 intersects a `state=CLOSED` + `since` listing with the `Blocked-by:` index. Through MCP `list_issues`, that listing holds no PRs: measured 2026-10-30, `since` 02:30Z, 15 rows and none a PR, while #27888, #27882 and #27870 merged inside the window. A PR target is found only by the forward scan.
- **`state-machine.md` 〈`pm:blocked`〉 points a PR wait at a card.** It says a card waiting on a PR merge names 「一张在该刻关闭的卡」 (the card the PR fixes). Option 1 allows the PR number itself. A target that is the fixed card avoids both the reverse-scan gap and the closed-unmerged question.
- **The patrol's H19 resolver shares the closed-unmerged reading.** `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` `resolveBlockerTarget` reads `/issues/N` `state` only, so it reports a block on a closed-unmerged PR as outlived. It is report-only, and the refresh is now the stricter of the two, in the direction that cannot release a card.

Also noted, not filed:

- H4 clears a card whose `Blocked-by:` is in a comment, while `platform-readings.md` says the seat unlock scan greps the body only. A comment-borne line passes H4 and stays invisible to that scan. `lanes/devx.md` says this repo deliberately keeps `Blocked-by:` in comments, which disagrees with the body-only rule.
- `state-machine.md`'s sentence on this refresh (「双通道目标全为本仓已关卡…」) does not yet say that a PR target must have merged.
- **Deviation:** the new line carries 「full-run 卡写评论」. The full-run card's body is rewritten on every red, and the refresh note already tells a seat to re-block it in a comment. A body line there would be erased by the next refresh and strand the card with no line. The seat may strike the clause.
- **Branch name.** The card thread's platform-assigned branch `claude/project-thread-ucikco` names no issue; claim 6514262092 (amended) is the identity record.

## Verification

- Ablation, `scheduled-full-run.mjs`: with `unmerged` forced to `false` the self-test fails with `expected a refresh judged 'held', got refreshed 'expired' (expired -- #24305 closed)`; restored byte-identical (`cmp`).
- Ablation, `scheduled-full-run-card.mjs`: with the projection back to `{ state, closed_at }` the new case fails (`github.rest.issues.addLabels` is not modelled by this case); restored byte-identical.
- Gates, head `928dcbc5` (merge base `2a3dec2d`): `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 40 families (re-derived after the commit: identical). After `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts`, each ran with its exit code recorded. `check:doc-formula-expressions` first exited 3 (prerequisite) and exited 0 after `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/formula --filter=@objectstack/lint`; the other 39 exited 0 on the first run. `--ran`: 40 derived, 40 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. This includes `check:pm-skill-ratchet` (triage-duties.md 102/102) and `check:pm-skill-id-lint`.
- Not measured locally, cited from CI instead: `check-half-states.mjs --format=markdown --provenance="$PROVENANCE"` (takes a workflow value), the `Plan Test Core shards` step, and the type-check lanes. This diff touches no TypeScript.
- `dispatch-gates --tier`: no path-derived mandate. 121 changed lines, under the 3000 threshold.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; ESLint (`--no-inline-config`) on the two changed scripts exits 0, and CI's `pnpm lint` is cited from the check-runs.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (publishes nothing: `skip-changeset`)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
